sources.notes: SSC's official notice confirms the 2024 Tier-I final answer keys and candidate response sheets were accessible from 19 December 2024 to 8 January 2025 via registered login and would not remain available afterward. The 2025 Tier-I notice says final answer keys and question papers would be published later; that notice is not itself an item-level question source. No static bank item has been matched to an SSC response sheet or final answer key in this audit.

The official RBI portal provides Grade B recruitment handouts, including the 2026 Phase-I handout and 2025 Phase-II handouts. Handouts establish exam instructions/format, not that an item appeared in an actual previous exam. No static bank item has been matched to an official past-paper record in this audit.
